summary.text: MERSALG AS (972 419 508), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 1994-10-26; address Brøsetvegen 164G, 7069 TRONDHEIM, Norge. Main industry is Intermediation service activities for non-specialised retail sale (47.910); 175 registered employees; 2 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Ståle André Schibbye; Board chair: Johan Magnus Von Schoultz; Auditor: GRANT THORNTON NORWAY AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 127.72 m, operating profit NOK 12.11 m, net profit NOK 10.37 m, equity NOK 20.11 m, total assets NOK 44.81 m. Official website https://www.mersalg.no/ is verified (the registry lists it and the site shows the registered name); company-owned profiles on facebook, linkedin.
